items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Romano? [INTERVIEWEE] No it wasn’t Joe, Joe Farrell was there a while...

ctx.x: No, not Babe Costello, no. It was George Glaskins. That’s who we both studied with. It was great man. I mean he didn’t know anything about jazz or anything like that, or playing a drumset, but he really, rudimentally, he was wonderful you know. And I still think about him, you know, like the way he did things when I went to his lesson you know, we’d have two practice pads set up and he’d — you know he had a beautiful roll man. I’m still working on that. And I think of him all the time.
So there’s a bit of an upstate mystery I’d like to just ask about — there’s Nistico, Romano, Esposito, Mancuso, Zito — like what’s that about?
